newsitem.title: UK: UK shares lose early gains as Wall Street wobbles.
newsitem.headline: UK shares lose early gains as Wall Street wobbles.

text.p: UK shares lost their early strong gains by the close on Thursday as a fresh bout of Wall Street weakness offset the positive effect of sharp falls in sterling and Bank of England comments that soothed interest rate fears.

A slump in Reed International also helped drag the market lower as analysts downgraded profit forecasts after a briefing by the company, and the FTSE 100 closed just 6.0 points higher at 4,051.2 after earlier being up some 31 points.
Rising stocks were in a five-to-four majority and volume was a robust 810 million shares. The Dow was off 13 points as London closed and the U.S. long bond was down over one point.
